our_interpretation: The antecedent requires a broad reduction in hyperscaler capital expenditure followed by declining NVIDIA GPU demand. Slower spending growth alone does not establish it.
Kill revenues means severe revenue declines, rather than literally zero sales.
A prolonged depression means a sustained, broad semiconductor contraction across multiple reporting periods.
The predicted sequence contains causal links; simultaneous share-price declines would not establish those links.
criteria.support_condition: After the documented spending-and-demand trigger, severe revenue declines spread through Taiwanese AI-server ODMs and RAM/storage suppliers into a sustained semiconductor contraction, with evidence supporting the claimed causal sequence. An attempted bailout fails to reverse that contraction.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the documented trigger, a completed downturn-and-recovery episode clearly breaks the predicted inevitable sequence, or an implemented bailout demonstrably reverses the downturn.
